correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    # Tile the input with its clockwise, half-turn, and counter-clockwise rotations.
    top_right = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    bottom_left = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    bottom_right = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [list(row) + top_right[i] for i, row in enumerate(grid)] + [bottom_left[i] + bottom_right[i] for i in range(n)]
